title: 3 Stocks To Buy Now (Best Investments September 2026)

keyPoints.text: The S&P 500 finished essentially flat as gains in the technology sector balanced declines across financial and industrial stocks amid declining oil prices.
Sofi tends to trade inversely with the federal funds rate, reflecting macroeconomic interest rate cut or hike expectations rather than being directly driven by oil prices.
The creator suggests that industry demand and run-up for peptides could eventually surpass GPUs because of their broad healthcare and weight-loss potential.
A company's executive leadership is a critical investment factor that is often overlooked in traditional financial analysis.
E.L.F. Beauty has shifted about 60% of its manufacturing outside of China and benefits from expanding international sales penetration.

Elevated oil prices create mounting macroeconomic problems, leading to more extreme control measures, with expectations that oil prices will decline significantly towards the 130 range by the end of next week.
Celsius is up over 5% including overnight trading as dropping oil prices benefit the company, making it the largest position in the public portfolio.

The creator highlights a 35% gain over the past month in Meta Platforms after buying it when it was cheap, emphasizing that buying blue-chip stocks at cheap valuations historically minimizes downside.
Hims & Hers carries a $7 billion market capitalization, a 52-week range of $13 to $65, and a negative P/E ratio, sitting around the midpoint of its 52-week range.

Hims & Hers is expanding internationally with rest-of-the-world revenue up 1,641%, subscriber count up 19% year-over-year, and monthly revenue per average subscriber increasing 21%, though its negative P/E ratio makes it more speculative.

Hims & Hers has significant international TAM expansion potential across Europe (200M+ people for mental health and labs), Canada (30M+ people), Australia (20M+), and Japan, making the risk-to-reward favorable despite currently lower international margins due to operational costs.

Hims & Hers is building out operational infrastructure to capture future growth in peptides and non-weight-loss healthcare categories, including a 503B outsourcing facility in California, 503A facilities in Arizona and Ohio, and an at-home lab testing facility in New Jersey.

Amazon's AWS net sales are up 37% year-over-year and operating income is up 64%, driven by heavy capital investments into long-term growth assets that are expected to yield higher returns over time before spending slows down.

E.L.F. is projected to achieve 18% to 20% net sales growth by 2027, and given its track record of beating earnings, sustained 20% growth warrants an expansion of its forward P/E from 28.59 into the 30s.
ServiceNow corrected its valuation to a forward P/E in the 30s reflecting its low 20% year-over-year revenue growth.
Anthony Noto has transformed SoFi from nothing to significant achievements, and despite the current share price not reflecting this progress, share appreciation is anticipated soon.
Falling oil prices and CEO leadership are expected to boost ELF's share price, and its international sales penetration could reach 42% over the next 6 years if historical doubling trends continue.

calls.thesis: The creator is actively buying shares of Hims & Hers, viewing the stock's risk-to-reward ratio as highly attractive driven by international expansion and long-term peptide opportunities despite a negative P/E ratio.
risks: Company currently has a negative P/E ratio
Higher operational risk and lower margins associated with international expansion

calls.thesis: The creator is accumulating shares of Amazon rapidly, viewing it as deceivingly cheap and well positioned for future growth led by AWS, despite elevated capital expenditures.
risks: Massive capital expenditure and potential debt taken on to fund rapid growth

calls.thesis: The creator holds a decent portfolio allocation in E.L.F. Beauty after re-entering the position, considering the stock severely undervalued with substantial ongoing runway for growth and a tendency to beat earnings expectations.
risks: Forward P/E ratio is somewhat elevated at 28.59

calls.thesis: Maintains a heavy portfolio investment in E.L.F. Beauty, considering it severely undervalued with strong runway for growth and forecasting it to become a $400 stock over the long term (a 4x gain in 3 to 7 years).
Projects Hims & Hers to reach $100 over a long-term 3 to 7 year horizon despite anticipated near-term volatility and regulatory dependency, actively investing heavily.
risks: Dependence on FDA approvals and external factors

calls.thesis: Expects Amazon to stage a rapid rally to $300 plus once it announces a slowdown in capital expenditures while sustaining its growth rates.
conditions: Amazon announces a slowdown in Capex and sustains current growth rates
